showOnHomepage.description: Whether to show this project on the homepage

company.description: Company or client the project was made for (empty or null for none)

startYear.description: Year the work started (null for none)

endYear.description: Year the work ended (null when not set or when the project is ongoing)

ongoing.description: The project is still running (the web shows startYear to the current year). true requires startYear and endYear null (400 otherwise). Omitted keeps the stored value (false for a new project)

translations.description: Translations, one per language. Those with a non-empty title are created or replaced; languages not listed (or with an empty title) keep their stored translation. At least one title is required

title.description: Title. A translation with an empty title is skipped and keeps what is stored

role.description: Role on the project, e.g. Frontend developer (empty or null clears it)

description.description: Short description (rich text, sanitised; null clears it)

content.description: Full content (rich text, sanitised; null clears it)

metaTitle.description: SEO meta title (empty or null clears it)

metaDescription.description: SEO meta description (empty or null clears it)

tagIds.description: Tag IDs in display order (replaces the assigned tags)

links.description: Links in display order, the first one is the main link (replaces the links)

label.description: Link label, e.g. GitHub (the web falls back to the domain when empty)

media.description: The complete media list in display order: existing rows to keep (`id`) and new files (`fileId`, `language`). Rows of the project that are not listed are removed

id.description: ID of an existing media row of this project to keep (omit for a new item)

fileId.description: File to add as a new media row (omit with `id`)

language.description: Language of a new media row (omit with `id`; null or omitted means all)

status.description: Publication status to set in the same transaction (needs the publish permission). Omit it to keep the current status; a new project is a draft

version.description: The `version` of the record the change is based on (from its detail). When another one is stored, nothing is written and the answer is 409 with the code VERSION_CONFLICT. Left out, the change is written without the check
